# Prism 1.30.0

Official files from https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/tree/v1.30.0.

Included components: core, Python, SQL, JSON, HTTP and PromQL. The build embeds
these files and their MIT license into `index.html`.

Textbook grammars and colors are maintained in `source/highlight.js` and
`source/highlight.css`.
